_comment: Skill activation + behavior evals for agent-retro. Run each across Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus. Shape follows the skill-writer eval contract: canonical trigger, ambiguous trigger (no skill name), and adjacent-but-wrong (should NOT activate).

scenarios.name: canonical-trigger
scenarios.query: Run a retro on my last week of sessions and harden my setup.
expected_behavior: Runs mine.py via 'uv run python3' with a ~7-day window
Runs the flywheel analyser via 'uv run python3', degrading gracefully if absent
Produces a ranked report split into GLOBAL and PROJECT buckets grouped by target_repo
Applies approved changes one at a time, using a shell heredoc for files under ~/.claude

scenarios.name: ambiguous-trigger-no-skill-name
scenarios.query: Claude keeps making the same mistakes with me — can we make it stop repeating them?
expected_behavior: Activates agent-retro even though the skill name is not mentioned
Mines transcripts for recurring friction rather than guessing
Proposes durable guardrails (CLAUDE.md rule, hook, or permission) grounded in evidence

scenarios.name: adjacent-but-wrong-should-not-activate
scenarios.query: Why did my last build fail?
expected_behavior: Does NOT activate agent-retro (this is debugging one build, not a cross-session friction retro)
Investigates the build failure directly instead
